blurb.en: Authentic Syrian-Lebanese halal cooking — shawarma, kebab, falafel and build-your-own bowls from Chef Adnan.
blurb.ar: مأكولات سورية لبنانية حلال أصيلة — شاورما، كباب، فلافل وأطباق تصنعها بنفسك من الشيف عدنان.

about.en: Just up the block from Mangos Cafe, our grill brings 100% halal Syrian-Lebanese cooking to Short North — marinated overnight, charred over an open flame.
about.ar: على بُعد خطوات من مانجوس كافيه، يقدّم مطعمنا مأكولات سورية لبنانية حلال ١٠٠٪ — مُتبّلة طوال الليل ومشوية على النار المكشوفة.

aboutImage.alt: Skewers of marinated chicken and kofta grilling over an open flame

note.en: Twenty years over the coals in Aleppo and Beirut, now grilling on Smith Place.
note.ar: عشرون عامًا على الفحم في حلب وبيروت، والآن على سميث بليس.

heroImage.alt: Mangos Mediterranean Grill storefront during the day

menu.title: Mediterranean Wraps
menu.intro: Fresh-off-the-flame fillings rolled in warm pita or saj bread, with garlic toum, pickles and crisp veg. Handheld, halal and made to order.

items.name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
items.details: Overnight-marinated chicken shaved off the spit, wrapped with our creamy garlic toum, house pickles and a squeeze of lemon.

items.name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
items.details: Thin-sliced spiced beef with nutty tahini, tomato and sumac onions, rolled tight and pressed on the flat top.

items.name: Falafel Wrap
items.details: House-fried falafel with hummus, tahini, tomato, cucumber and pickled turnips — fully plant-based.

items.name: Chicken Kebab Wrap
items.details: Charcoal-grilled shish tawook with garlic toum and pickles, wrapped in warm saj bread.

items.name: Beef Kofta Wrap
items.details: Hand-mixed beef kofta grilled over flame, with tahini, parsley and sumac onions.

items.name: Halloumi Wrap
items.details: Golden grilled halloumi with za'atar, tomato and greens — a vegetarian favorite.

menu.title: Burgers
menu.intro: Halal smash burgers with a Mediterranean twist — griddled on the flat top and stacked on a toasted brioche bun.

items.name: Classic Smash
items.description: Double halal beef, cheese, house sauce
items.details: Two smashed halal beef patties, American cheese, pickles and our house sauce on toasted brioche.

items.name: Mango Grill Burger
items.details: Our signature — halal beef topped with grilled halloumi, sweet tomato jam and peppery arugula.

items.name: Spicy Harissa Burger
items.details: A kick of North African harissa mayo with pickled onions and melted pepper jack.

items.name: Shawarma Chicken Burger
items.details: A griddled shawarma-spiced chicken patty with garlic toum and pickles.

items.name: Falafel Burger
items.details: A crisp falafel patty with tahini slaw and tomato — hearty and meat-free.

items.name: Kofta Burger
items.description: Grilled kofta patty, tahini, sumac onion
items.details: A flame-grilled kofta patty with tahini and sumac onions on toasted brioche.

menu.title: Salads
menu.intro: Bright, herb-forward salads dressed in lemon, olive oil and sumac. Add any grilled protein to make it a meal.

items.name: Fattoush
items.details: Crisp romaine, tomato, cucumber and radish with sumac dressing and crunchy fried pita.

items.name: Tabbouleh
items.details: Finely chopped parsley and mint with bulgur, tomato and a lemon-olive oil dressing.

items.name: Mediterranean Salad
items.details: Chopped greens with feta, kalamata olives, cucumber, tomato and red onion in lemon vinaigrette.

items.name: Chicken Shawarma Salad
items.details: A full bed of greens topped with shawarma chicken, pickles and a garlic toum drizzle.

items.name: Hummus Plate
items.details: Silky house hummus pooled with olive oil and paprika, served with warm pita.

items.name: Mezze Sampler
items.details: A little of everything — hummus, tabbouleh, two falafel and warm pita to share.

menu.title: Chef Adnan's Grilled Entrées
menu.intro: Charcoal-grilled platters straight off Chef Adnan's flame, served with saffron rice, grilled veg, salad and warm pita.

items.name: Chef's Mixed Grill
items.details: The full board — shish tawook, beef kofta and lamb chops over saffron rice with grilled veg and pita. Built to share.

items.name: Shish Tawook
items.details: Marinated chicken skewers grilled over charcoal, served with garlic toum, rice and salad.

items.name: Beef Kofta Kebab
items.details: Hand-mixed beef and parsley kofta grilled on skewers, with sumac onions, rice and salad.

items.name: Grilled Lamb Chops
items.details: Four marinated lamb chops charred over flame, served with saffron rice and grilled veg.

items.name: Grilled Salmon
items.details: A lemon-herb marinated salmon fillet grilled to order with rice and salad.

items.name: Falafel Platter
items.details: Six house falafel with hummus, tahini, saffron rice and salad — fully plant-based.

bowl.title: Build Your Own Bowl
bowl.intro: Four steps, endless combinations. Pick your base, your protein off the grill, a spread and as many toppings as you like — Chef Adnan builds it in front of you.

steps.title: Choose your toppings
steps.hint: Pick as many as you like
